name: Question 2
problem:
Calculate the product $Q{I}_{2}$ given that ${I}_{2}$ is the $2\times 2$ identity matrix and
$Q=[\begin{aligned}7 & -7 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
Any matrix, when multiplied by an identity matrix, remains unchanged (assuming that the multiplication is well defined).

The matrix $Q$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix and ${I}_{2}$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix too. 

Therefore, the multiplication is well defined and 

$$
Q\cdot {I}_{2}=Q=[\begin{aligned}7 & -7 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Question 2
?

Calculate the product QI2 given that I2 is the 2×2 identity matrix and Q=[7−701].

a
[01−77]
b
[7−701]
c
[−770−1]
d
[−7701]
e
[−7710]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Any matrix, when multiplied by an identity matrix, remains unchanged (assuming that the multiplication is well defined).

The matrix Q is a 2×2 matrix and I2 is a 2×2 matrix too.

Therefore, the multiplication is well defined and

Q⋅I2=Q=[7−701].
